## Authentication
Cookie-based (session-id) — Authentication method detected from captured traffic.

### Providing credentials
- Prefer passing auth as request headers or cookies at call time (do not hardcode secrets into the skill).
- If executing via an external proxy/executor, pass per-call credentials (cookies and/or headers) so they are not persisted.

- Runtime capable of HTTPS requests.
- If using `scripts/api.ts`: TypeScript toolchain (or transpile to JS).

- `GET /images/I/{IToken}` — Retrieve an image using an image token.

- `GET /images/I/{IToken}` — Retrieve an advertising image.

### Data Read (15)
- `GET /ap/{apId}` — Get details for a specific AP (Advertising Product).
- `GET /assets/remote-components/cm-cdn-assets.json` — Get configuration data for remote components.
- `GET /axconsole/common/ATVPDKIKX0DER/{ATVPDKIKX0DERId}` — Get common data for a specific Amazon entity.

- `GET /axconsole/pagelevel/UCMCampaignsAppService/CampaignManagerLandingPage.AdvertiserLevel/ATVPDKIKX0DER/{ATVPDKIKX0DERId}` — Get page-level data for Campaign Manager Landing Page.
- `GET /campaign-manager` — Get campaign manager data for a specific entity.
- `GET /ccx/ajax/{ajaxId}` — Retrieve data via an AJAX call.
- `GET /cm/campaigns` — Retrieve a list of advertising campaigns for an entity.
- `GET /cm/smart-search/dist/translations/{translationId}` — Get translations for smart search.
- `GET /communications/drawerStrings` — Get communication drawer strings for an entity.
- `GET /communications/placements/{placementId}` — Get details for a specific advertising placement.
- `GET /recommendations/api/placements/globalallcampaigns/cards` — Get recommendations for global all-campaign placements.
- `GET /sauron/help/content/{contentId}` — Retrieve help content by ID.
- `GET /sauron/help/getcontent` — Retrieve help content based on entity and other parameters.
- `GET /translations/{translationId}` — Retrieve a specific translation.

- `POST /communications/metrics/drawer/loadTime` — Report drawer load time metrics.

## About This Skill

This skill provides access to Advertising Amazon's internal API — the hidden endpoints that power their web/mobile app.
These are NOT official public APIs. They were captured by observing network traffic while using the site.

**Important:**
- Auth tokens in `auth.json` may expire — re-capture if you get 401 errors
- Internal APIs can change without notice — endpoints may break
- Rate limits are unknown — be conservative with request frequency

## When to Use This Skill

Use this skill when you need to:
- Access Advertising Amazon data without official API access
- Automate actions on advertising.amazon.com (faster than browser automation)
- Call the same endpoints the Advertising Amazon frontend uses
